skills.name: Infinite Extension
skills.description:
Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 425<font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies it passes through.
The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the <font color='#404495'>(Mystic Barrier)</font> (up to 5 times).

skills.name: Mystic Field
skills.description:
Xavier conjures a <font color='#404495'>(Mystic Barrier)</font> that lasts 5s. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier will take 125<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s.
When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a <font color='#404495'>(Mystic Field)</font> for 3s, dealing 300<font color='#27C0C7'>( +120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

skills.name: Dawning Light
skills.description:
Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 650<font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to all enemies along its path.
Once cast, he also directly enters the <font color='#404495'>(Transcendence)</font> state and resets the state's duration.

skills.name: Transcendence
skills.description:
Xavier enhances his subsequent skills each time his skill hits an enemy hero. <font color='#404495'>(Stage I:)</font> Increases Movement Speed by 50% when subsequent skills hit, decaying over 1.2s. <font color='#404495'>(Stage II:)</font> Width of subsequent skills will be greatly increased. <font color='#404495'>(Stage III:)</font> Skill Cooldown reduced by 4s (12s for the Ultimate). At <font color='#404495'>(Stage III)</font>, Xavier enters the <font color='#404495'>(Transcendence)</font> state.
<font color='#404495'>(Transcendence:)</font> All of Xavier's skills are enhanced to <font color='#404495'>(Stage III)</font> state for 5s (this duration is extended by 1s each time Xavier's skill hits an enemy).

items.name: Enchanted Talisman
items.des: Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.des: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.des: Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.
